meta.name: The Devil of the Desert Against the Son of Hercules
meta.description:
The daughter of a well-off man is sold into slavery, only to be later rescued by the film's hero.

This film was originally a European (primarily Italian) film called "Anthar l'invincibile" which was later dubbed into English.

You can find more information regarding this film on its IMDb page. 

More information on the film series is also available from the Wikipedia article here.
